note: How a workspace moves from one metamodel (metamodel) version to the next — `sdem migrate --workspace DIR`. Every change to the metamodel that affects data bumps metamodel_version in every metamodel file and adds one entry here, from the old version to the new: its steps are applied to the workspace's datasets and registry, then the workspace is checked; an entry with no steps only moves the version (an additive change — new optional attributes or types). Step kinds: rename_type {from, to}; rename_attribute {type (optional), from, to}; drop_attribute {type (optional), name}; set_attribute {type, name, value} (only where missing); rename_kind {from, to} (a within-architecture link kind); rename_relationship {from, to} (a link type between architectures, in the registry). Policy: docs/sdem-metamodel-versioning.md.

migrations.note: DA2-02: a BIAN service domain's asset_type and functional_pattern are required unless its new classification attribute is 'unknown' (domains BIAN does not publish them for). Additive — no steps; existing data is unchanged.
DA2-03: a BIAN service domain's classification may be 'inferred', with inference_ref naming the entry in SDEM's inference record. Additive — no steps; existing data is unchanged.
DA2-05: every record type may carry the inferred mark (records sdem aid infers into a workspace). DA2-04: rule S06 requires the activity to cover at least half of the asset type. Additive — no steps.

B1 cross-layer link review (docs/design/b1-cross-layer-link-review.md). DEPLOYED_ON now targets only what hosts software — A4.Node, A4.Device, A4.SystemSoftware (and their subtypes) — verified against ArchiMate 3.2; it replaces COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_INFRASTRUCTURE with COMPONENT_DEPLOYED_ON_NODE / _DEVICE / _SYSTEM_SOFTWARE. A connection that named the supertype gets its record's own type; a DEPLOYED_ON connection to anything else (a technology service, interface, network, path, artifact, environment) no longer passes — the migration refuses and lists it for a person to re-point or supersede. DEPLOYED_AS grounded in ArchiMate (confidence high); VALUE_STREAM_ALIGNED_TO_SCENARIO authority corrected to enterprise_rule; two link types re-cited to BIAN Release Notes 14.0.
